purpose: Monitor the Taiwan equity market through the existing governed HENGCE EOD vessel using paid FinMind data. TWSE and TPEx are the primary broad-market scope; emerging equities are monitored separately and also included in an umbrella all-Taiwan diagnostic, but lower emerging-board snapshot coverage may not block the TWSE+TPEx monitor.

data_vessel.membership_rule: take latest date row per stock_id; classify current membership by type; filter to four-digit equities and exclude ETF/ETN/TDR-like non-common-equity rows

scope_semantics.twse_tpex_all_equities: primary broad Taiwan exchange-equity monitor: current TWSE plus TPEx equities
scope_semantics.emerging_equities: current emerging-board equities; monitored separately because trading and liquidity microstructure differ and snapshot coverage may differ
scope_semantics.all_taiwan_equities: umbrella diagnostic combining TWSE, TPEx and emerging equities; coverage is always disclosed and does not by itself gate the primary monitor
scope_semantics.hengce_electronics100_diagnostic: legacy operating-universe diagnostic only; no longer represents the whole market

coverage_gate.rule: Fail closed only if TWSE or TPEx primary-market coverage falls below 98%. Emerging and umbrella all-Taiwan coverage must be reported but may not block the primary monitor.

allowed_persisted_derived_context: cross-sectional change-rate mean/median/quantiles in vendor units
cross-sectional median absolute change rate in vendor units
aggregate turnover and top-10 turnover share
explicitly_not_authorized: persisting raw or per-ticker FinMind snapshot rows in this Market State auxiliary
using Electronics100 as the primary whole-market observation scope
silently treating incomplete emerging coverage as complete
changing frozen S5 Market State features
creating or selecting a new state label
